title: Concerning Food: It shall be allocated to Five Products of the human Body.
text:
⟨p.258⟩
104
— Concerning the food, that it habitually divides into —
104 five offspring upon the body of man 104
{4} again he said to his disciples: 'This food which
men gather inward in various likenesses,
as they eat it: when it goes inward into the body, it habitually disperses
forth into five offspring. The first offspring is this one which habitually
comes forth from the man through the breathing-out, and mounts upon
the mind, and it comes forth from all his members, and there is no me{5} to
it. The second is this one which habitually comes forth from the man
through the voice and the speech. The third is this which
habitually pours forth from there through the power and the shame.
The fourth is that which they habitually beget through the pleasure of desi{6}
in males and in females. The fifth is this one
which they habitually mold and depict in the flesh, and
they beget it, and it comes forth from there — which is the bodily
offspring. This offspring which they beget — its fathers
know it, according to his desire of heart and his
{7} and his {8}, which they seek after daily, in
every season. But the other four offspring, they do not perceive
them, neither are they sick at heart for them, since
they are not made manifest to them.' —
